data_backup_description: Download a complete snapshot of your business data as an Excel file. Store it somewhere safe (e.g. Google Drive, external drive) for disaster recovery.
old_sales_cleanup_description: After you have backed up your data, permanently delete sale records older than one year to keep the local database smaller.
delete_old_sales_confirm: This will permanently delete sale records older than one year. Please make sure you downloaded a backup first. Continue?
delete_old_sales_failed: Failed to delete old sale records
system_shutdown_description: Use the button below to safely shut down the system. Make sure to save all your work before proceeding.
system_shutdown_demo_disabled: This demo runs entirely in your browser, so the desktop power-off button is disabled. Close the tab to sign out of the demo.
restart_app_to_apply_changes: Please restart the app to apply these changes.
shop_info_conflict: Shop information was changed by someone else while you were editing it. Please refresh and try again.
currency_helper: Used to display all prices and amounts across the app
tax_percentage_helper: Percent added on top of the subtotal for every sale (0.00 = no tax).
discount_type_helper: Choose how discounts are applied in your shop.
discount_percentage_helper: Percent subtracted from the subtotal on every sale.
discount_amount_mode_hint: Cashiers will enter the discount amount at checkout. It is capped at the subtotal.
backup_description: Automatically back up your entire database to your personal Google Drive as an Excel file.
drive_connected_description: Your database backups will be automatically saved to your connected Google Drive account.
drive_disconnected_description: Connect your Google account to enable automated cloud backups. (You will be asked to grant permission to create files).
drive_connect_failed: Failed to connect Google Drive. Please try again.
disconnect_confirm: Are you sure you want to disconnect Google Drive? Automated backups will stop.
cron_format_helper: Format: Seconds Minutes Hours Day-of-Month Month Day-of-Week
custom_date_range_helper: Leave blank to backup ALL data. Select a range to backup only transactions within these dates.
language_preferences_description: Choose the language used across the app. This is saved to your account.
export_backup_description: Downloads a single JSON file containing all products, categories, customers, suppliers, sales, and purchases. Save it to a USB drive for safekeeping.
invalid_backup_file: ❌ Invalid backup file — please choose a DeShop backup JSON
merge_mode_description: Keeps existing records, adds new ones, updates matching IDs. Best for combining data.
replace_mode_description: DELETES all current data first, then loads the backup. Use after a fresh install.
replace_all_warning: This will permanently delete ALL current products, sales, customers, and purchases before loading the backup file.
replace_all_tip: Tip: Export your current data first as a safety copy.
confirm_irreversible: I understand this cannot be undone
shutdown_confirm: Are you sure you want to shut down DeShop?
server_stopped: Server has been stopped. You can close this window.
rc_subtitle: Design your receipt. The preview on the right is a true 1:1 representation of your physical paper.
rc_header_helper: Banner shown near the top. Leave blank to hide.
rc_scaled_tooltip: Preview is scaled down to fit on screen. The proportions are exact.
rc_preview_1to1: This preview is 1:1 scale with the physical paper.
rc_preview_scaled: Physical paper is {{width}}mm wide. Preview is scaled to fit.
counter_printer_desc: Prints receipts on the printer attached to the DeShop server computer. Every device — phone, tablet, browser — can use it without installing anything.
counter_printer_helper: Leave empty to use the Windows default printer.
counter_printer_test_ok: Test page sent! Check the printer.
remote_auth_desc: For security, Google returns you to the DeShop main computer after sign-in. Since you are on another device, open the link below on the MAIN computer (the one running the server) — or open DeShop there and press Connect.
